title: Dead Ringer mod
description: Add the Dead Ringer from Team Fortress 2
body:
This Minecraft mod add the Dead Ringer from Team Fortress 2 for the 1.19.2 version of the game.

This watch won't make your armor invisible but give you 30 seconds of overheal. It can also break if you remove it from your off-hand during the cooldown and will take some gold to repair.

Here's the Wiki page for the item : [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Dead_Ringer](https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Dead_Ringer)
